question: Can the existing gauge parity complete the internal quarter operation without an additional parent and restore the required fermionic matter?
kills: Identify a trivial ordinary bosonic Z8 pullback with anomaly cancellation of the unchanged physical Z4 quotient.
Trivialize the given global Spin-Z8f torsion anomaly by an odd gauge lift q=2t+k*g within the specified 9R+1L candidate.
Identify the elementary vector fermions of the D8 to integer-lattice extension with the required Spin(10) x Spin(6) spinor matter solely from the number 16.
assumptions: The supplied 9R+1L compact gauge candidate with fixed K,g,t,F is granted, not derived from P1/P2.
The bosonic internal Z4 anomaly is represented by the stated omega.
The fermionic anomaly comparison treats Uhat globally before/without a dynamical U1 quotient.
Fermionization uses a spin structure and twisted sectors of the stipulated chiral lattice theory.
The K0 bound assumes the supplied Gaussian action, common normal ordering and separated insertions.
leaves_open: Native origin of the candidate field content, locality, gauge connection and kinetic coefficients.
Common source construction of physical time, state and anomaly compensation.
Charged spinor matter with the required group action and a common 3+1D realization.
Complete T1-T8 closure including gravity and initial-state selection.
not_claimed: No-go for TFPT or other parent completions.
A globally anomalous symmetry is itself inconsistent.
Complete anomaly classification after dynamical U1 gauging.
Reproduction of the unattached cocycle matrix A or 57600 phase tests.
External peer review or a complete TOE.
summary_de: Ein expliziter Achterlift trivialisiert die zurueckgezogene bosonische Z4-Klasse, aber seine Korrekturphase steigt nicht auf den physischen Quotienten ab. Alle ungeraden Eichlifts behalten im globalen Spin-Z8f-Vergleich die Torsionsklasse eins. Die direkte Fermionisierung ergibt 16 Vektorfermionen mit 10+6 statt des benoetigten Spinoranschlusses. Kein physisches Gesamttor geschlossen.
